# UX Requirements Checklist: macOS Passthrough Release Hardening

**Purpose**: Validate requirements quality for truthful non-recording status, recovery guidance, accessibility, and clean-room wording.
**Created**: 2026-06-01
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.

## Requirement Completeness

- [X] CHK001 Are UI requirements defined for ready, active, stale, degraded, failed, blocked, repair, and recheck states? [Completeness, Spec §FR-010, Spec §FR-011]
- [X] CHK002 Are requirements explicit that passthrough active/ready must not imply recording, transcription, or capture has started? [Completeness, Spec §FR-010, Spec §SC-008]
- [X] CHK003 Are recovery guidance requirements defined for stale, degraded, failed, or blocked routes without claiming the route is safe? [Completeness, Spec §US5 Acceptance Scenarios]
- [X] CHK004 Are accessibility and localization-safe status text requirements included for status and recovery UI? [Completeness, Spec §Constitutional Requirements]

## Requirement Clarity

- [X] CHK005 Is "non-recording passthrough" phrased as a product state clearly distinct from recording, transcript-only, and capture-active states? [Clarity, Spec §FR-010]
- [X] CHK006 Are requirements clear that UI cannot rely on color alone for readiness, warning, or repair states? [Clarity, Spec §Constitutional Requirements]
- [X] CHK007 Are repair and recheck actions described as next actions rather than hidden automatic acceptance? [Clarity, Spec §FR-011]
- [X] CHK008 Is the scope of screenshots or notes for UX readiness evidence bounded to avoid meeting content? [Clarity, Spec §Key Entities, Spec §FR-012]

## Requirement Consistency

- [X] CHK009 Are UX requirements consistent with visible local control and no-surprise recording rules in the constitution? [Consistency, Spec §Constitutional Requirements]
- [X] CHK010 Are non-recording UX requirements consistent with automatic startup being limited to local passthrough only? [Consistency, Spec §FR-009, Spec §FR-010]
- [X] CHK011 Are brand-distance requirements explicit enough to avoid copied Krisp UI, wording, or layout assumptions? [Consistency, Spec §FR-015, Spec §UX/Brand/Accessibility Impact]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [X] CHK012 Can truthful UI copy be objectively reviewed for whether it communicates passthrough without implying recording? [Measurability, Spec §SC-008]
- [X] CHK013 Are UX evidence requirements traceable to ready, active, stale, degraded, failed, repair, and non-recording states? [Traceability, Spec §Key Entities]
- [X] CHK014 Are browser target skip decisions visible enough in evidence and UI-facing release notes to avoid false acceptance? [Measurability, Spec §FR-013]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [X] CHK015 Are requirements defined for the user opening the app immediately after install before Core Audio publication completes? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [X] CHK016 Are requirements defined for the user seeing virtual devices while live passthrough evidence is missing? [Coverage, Spec §FR-011]
- [X] CHK017 Are future recording-assisted acceptance states explicitly deferred so current UI work does not introduce customer-facing recording automation? [Coverage, Spec §FR-016, Contract deferred-recording]

## Notes

- Focus areas selected: non-recording status clarity, recovery guidance, accessibility, and brand distance.
- Depth level: release-gate requirements review.
- Actor/timing: reviewer before `$speckit-tasks` and `$speckit-analyze`.
